conversations.title: Conversation 2
conversations.description: Anton Wijaya informs the hotel about his late arrival.
lines: Good morning. The Plaza Hotel. How can I help you?
Good morning. My name is Anton Wijaya. I have {{0}} reservations for this Friday, leaving {{1}}. One is for me and one is for Dr. Little.
Just one moment, Mr. Wijaya, let me just check that. Yes, I have it here. Arriving Friday, the {{2}} for {{3}} nights. Is there a problem?
Not really. It’s just that I’ve changed my plans, and I’m taking a later flight. We land at {{4}}, so I can’t be at the hotel before {{5}}.
That’s not a problem, Mr. Wijaya. We have someone at reception twenty-four hours a day.
Oh, that’s good. I can take a taxi from the airport, so I expect to arrive at {{6}} at the latest.
That’s fine, Mr. Wijaya. I can inform my colleagues of your late arrival.
Thanks a lot. By the way, Dr. Little’s flight is not as late as mine. He’ll be there earlier than me.
OK. Well, have a good flight, Mr. Wijaya.
